nodes.summary: Let $x, y, s$ be real numbers with $2 \le y < x$ and $0 < s < 1$. Call a positive integer $y$-smooth if all its prime factors are at most $y$ (so $1$ is $y$-smooth). Let $S(x, y)$ be the sum of $1/n$ over the $y$-smooth integers $n > x$, and let $\zeta(\sigma, y)$ be the sum of $n^{-\sigma}$ over all $y$-smooth integers $n$. Then $S(x, y) \le x^{-s} \zeta(1 - s, y)$, where both series converge.
nodes.title: Rankin's bound for reciprocal sums of smooth numbers

nodes.summary: Write $\ell_2(p)$ for the multiplicative order of $2$ modulo a prime $p$. Let $p$ be an odd prime and $k$ a natural number, and let $F_p(k)$ be the sum of $1/N$ over the integers $N$ with $e^k < N \le e^{k+1}$, $N \equiv p \pmod{p\,\ell_2(p)}$ and $N > p$. Then $F_p(k) \le 2 / (p\,\ell_2(p))$.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.
